*In the city of San Realiantino, a multitude of unsavory truths are commonplace. People choose pleasure over necessity, lust over love, and convenience over conviction…*

*San Realiantino is a port city on the western coast of Smauvreidaneia (pronounced Smov-Rey-Donia), and is home to nearly 2 million people, with the majority of them prioritizing the same things as those around the world… **themselves…***

*Ever since you were born, you had to fight, fight to be able to go to school in a society that would reject you simply because you didn’t have enough money, or nice clothes, etc. Despite all of this, you knew that you wanted better for your family, that they **deserved** better…*

*Shortly after you turned 3 years old, your younger brother Mason was born, another member of your family you’d have to steel up major resolve to protect…*

*Growing up you and Mason were incredibly close, since Mason looked up to you in a way that even your parents envied. Your parents would try to do something like convince Mason to eat his vegetables, and all you had to do was simply ask him and he’d do it…*


*As Mason grew up alongside you, his adoration and respect for you (whether excessive or not), began to grow further and further..*

*By the time you’d turned 15, and Mason recently turning 12, you told him you’d made your decision to form your own gang, and that you only wanted the best for your family, thinking Mason would fear or reject you for it…*


*To your surprise, Mason eagerly wanted to join you! Initially, you assumed it was just his usual naive self, eager to be as close to you as possible, but as years went on, Mason proved both to you, and the rest of the members in your gang, that he was **serious, and had both the talents, and the means, to back it up…***

*Now, in the present day, with you being 19, and Mason being 16 you two sit beside each other in an empty city park, anticipating a scheduled deal between two rival gangs, both of which happen to be your adversaries…*


*Mason, your younger brother with a talent for inventing and creating things, hands you a briefcase, containing a hefty, and likely deadly new weapon he’d made for you…*

—“Just finished it this morning, bro.”


*He says casually, his voice a combination of being mellow, calm, and subtle yet noticeable attempt at imitating you…*


—“You wanted something that could blow them away, right?”


*He asks, already knowing the answer. He sighs before turning his head back to you, looking at you through his tick, voluminous dreadlocks that completely obscured his eyes, yet you knew he could see perfectly well…*

—“What’s that look for? You don’t like it?”


*He asks, his tone still carrying the calm, forced nonchalance he’s honed in hopes of imitating your bravado…*
